profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tempus AI
profile.summary:
* Team Leader * Solution Creator *
* Software Architect, Engineer, Developer *

* Fluent in many programming languages: Java, Spring, SQL, Perl, C, etc
* Designs and implements web applications using Java/Spring, TypeScript/NodeJS, etc
* Designs and implements database solutions using Oracle PL/SQL, T-SQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc
* Experienced in Object-Oriented analysis and design principles, SOLID architecture, etc
* Creative thinker and problem-solver, always focused on the bigger picture

Specialties: 
* Creating software solutions to business problems
* Design, code, deploy: APIs, Algorithms, Databases
* SOLID, design patterns, microservices
* Clear and effective oral and written communications
* Quickly learning new environments, technologies, languages
